faqs.q: Sec. 102-66. - Regulation of use of water; failure to comply.
faqs.a:
(a)
The city council may by ordinance limit, restrict, or authorize regulation of the
               time, duration or day of water usage for domestic and irrigation purposes, the amount
               of water used, the method or usage, the purpose of the usage and such other regulations
               and restrictions as it shall, from time-to-time, deem necessary to conserve and protect
               the water supplies of the city and the distribution thereof. Any person failing to
               abide by such regulation and restriction is guilty of a violation of this Code and
               subject to the penalties and charges authorized in
section 102-106
. In addition to any other penalty, the city, after notice and hearing, may discontinue
               water service to any violator.
(b)
Prior to implementation of any restrictions, limitations or regulation of the use
               of water for domestic or irrigation purposes pursuant to this section, the city council
               shall, by resolution, declare the existence of necessity for such restrictions, limitations,
               or regulation, as well as the authorization of implementation of any regulations adopted
               in furtherance thereof, or of any modifications thereto.
(Code 1981, § 33-39; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 3755, § 2, 7-1-2002)
